verdict.rationale: Kino is an agent-driven video editor that exposes an MCP server, so a browsable catalog of agent skills is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions a skills registry, leaderboard, or marketplace. The '100+ templates' library is a catalog of video design assets (titles, maps, captions, transitions), not installable agent skills, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or search a catalog of available skills — a registry, leaderboard, or marketplace listing — before installing anything
